meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建可渲染的画面合成项目,用时间轴排好片段并校验输出。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做逐帧可复现的媒体合成并需要校验。
copy.tagline_en: Build renderable composition projects with clips, tracks, and validated output.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you assemble frame-accurate compositions and need deterministic, validated renders.

howto.what: 它会按 HyperFrames 的合成契约替你写可渲染的 HTML 合成:用 data-* 属性声明时间、注册一条暂停的时间线、由框架接管视频音频播放,并在渲染前用 lint 校验。
howto.when: 在你动手写合成 HTML 之前接管,涉及合成结构、data-* 时间属性、clip 轨道、子合成等话题时。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 建一个能渲染的合成,先给最小骨架
say.note: 它会从最小可渲染骨架开始搭

say.text: 检查这个合成 HTML 的 data-* 时间属性和 clip 轨道对不对
跑 npx hyperframes timeline 列出所有轨道和片段
say.note: 输出时间线清单,不用逐个读文件

howto.what_en: It writes a renderable HyperFrames HTML composition to the contract: timing via data-* attributes, one paused timeline registered at window.__timelines, framework-owned media playback, and lint validation before render.
howto.when_en: Takes over before you write composition HTML — composition structure, data-* timing attributes, clip tracks, sub-compositions, and more.

say_en.text: Build me a renderable HyperFrames composition — start from the smallest skeleton
say_en.note: It starts from the minimal renderable skeleton

say_en.text: Check the data-* timing attributes and clip tracks in this composition HTML
say_en.note: It checks the file against the contract rules

say_en.text: Run npx hyperframes timeline to list every track and clip
say_en.note: Prints the timeline instead of reading each file
